name: cstoken-finops
description: CSTOKEN FinOps for Claude Code (for CSTOKEN customers): describe a task and get the right Claude model, effort, skills and plugins for it (clef-flash classification), apply the pick in one press, and track what your turns cost.

apiKey.title: CSTOKEN FinOps organisation key
apiKey.description: The organisation key your CSTOKEN contact gave you. Empty: CSTOKEN_FINOPS_API_KEY from the environment. FinOps is for CSTOKEN customers and needs this key.

endpoint.title: CSTOKEN FinOps API URL
endpoint.description: Leave empty to use https://finops.cstoken.net (or CSTOKEN_FINOPS_ENDPOINT from the environment).

autoOpen.title: Open the pane at session start
autoOpen.description: Opens the CSTOKEN FinOps pane beside the transcript when the session starts. Off: the line above the prompt opens it on demand.

shareInstalled.title: Send installed skill names
shareInstalled.description: Sends the names and one-line descriptions of installed commands, skills and MCP servers so they can be ranked. Never file contents.
